domains.name: data_processing
domains.summary: File formats, ETL, database querying, data recovery, transformation, and validation workflows.
domains.description:
#Data Processing Task Builder
Domain lens: Data processing tasks center on turning messy local artifacts and local data stores into trustworthy structured outputs. Good fits include CSV, JSON, JSONL, XML, Parquet, logs, calendars, SQLite, SQL joins, query plans, WAL recovery, graph queries, mixed source bundles, and adjacent workflows.
Task variety: Vary the workflow across cleaning, normalization, streaming transforms, schema reconciliation, record linkage, database repair, reporting queries, index tuning, invoice or document extraction, deterministic text rewrites, and multi-source ETL with conflict reporting. Prefer concrete local files or databases, partially broken inputs, and practical deliverables over abstract algorithm prompts.
Observable evidence: Useful success signals include generated reports, manifests, reject logs, normalized datasets, repaired databases, exact result tables, recovered rows, query-plan improvements, checksums, stable ordering, and documented handling of malformed records.
skills: classify documents and extract invoice totals
summarize log severities by date range
convert mixed files into normalized reports

domains.name: data_science
domains.summary: Exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, experiment analysis, anomaly investigation, and reproducible reporting tasks.
domains.description:
#Data Science Task Builder

Good fits include exploratory summaries, missingness audits, hypothesis tests, regression, Bayesian analysis, sampling, anomaly investigation, feature analysis, visualization, metric interpretation, and adjacent workflows.
Task variety: Vary between analysis reports, experiment readouts, leakage-aware feature audits, uncertainty estimates, cohort comparisons, anomaly triage, statistical model fitting, reproducible notebooks or scripts, and compact decision-support artifacts. Observable evidence: Useful success signals include summary tables, statistical metrics, confidence or credible intervals, residual reports, deterministic plots or chart data, anomaly lists, cleaned analysis datasets, and reproducible narrative reports.

domains.name: debugging
domains.summary: Error diagnosis, root cause analysis, performance debugging, memory issues, and concurrency bugs.
domains.description:
#Debugging Task Builder
Domain lens: Debugging tasks start from observable failure signals and ask for an evidence-backed repair. Good fits include tracebacks, logs, failing commands, compatibility breaks, release-only crashes, memory misuse, race conditions, performance regressions, brittle migrations, and adjacent workflows.
Task variety: Vary between root-cause fixes, minimal reproductions, dependency upgrades, legacy rewrites, compiler/runtime compatibility, instrumentation, static-analysis cleanup, and behavior-preserving optimizations. Include enough surrounding files for investigation rather than presenting a single obvious bug.
Observable evidence: Useful success signals include corrected behavior, stable outputs, passing command-line workflows, benchmark improvements, regression artifacts, log changes, preserved edge cases, and clear failure reproduction before the fix.
skills: fix compiler failures from runtime changes
reimplement legacy programs in modern languages
modernize code while preserving side effects
preserve exact outputs while optimizing code

domains.name: file_operations
domains.summary: File I/O, directory operations, file formats, compression, and filesystem metadata tasks.
domains.description:
#File Operations Task Builder

Observable evidence: Useful success signals include exact file trees, rewritten files, manifests, permission bits, archive contents, sorted outputs, checksums, error handling behavior, and absence of unwanted extra files.
skills: process files with spaces and unicode names
